title: Smart Task Manager
description: A full-featured task management web app with drag-and-drop, priority tagging, and local storage persistence. Supports dark/light mode and responsive design.
longDescription: Built entirely in Vanilla JS, this task manager lets users create, edit, delete, and prioritize tasks with a beautiful glassmorphism UI. Features include drag-and-drop reordering, category filters, deadline reminders, and theme switching. All data is stored in localStorage for persistence without a backend.

title: DSA Visualizer
description: Interactive visualizer for sorting algorithms and data structures. Animates Bubble Sort, Merge Sort, Quick Sort, and Binary Search in real-time.
longDescription: This educational tool helps CS students visualize how sorting algorithms work step-by-step. Built with Canvas API and JavaScript, it renders animated bars for each algorithm with speed controls, pause/resume functionality, and color-coded comparisons and swaps.

title: Mini Shell (OS Project)
description: A custom Unix-like shell implemented in C supporting piping, redirection, background processes, and built-in commands like cd, pwd, exit.
longDescription: Developed as part of an Operating Systems course project, this shell supports command parsing, process forking, exec calls, I/O redirection with < and >, piping with |, background execution with &, and built-in commands. Demonstrates deep understanding of POSIX system calls and process management.

title: Portfolio Website
description: This very portfolio! A modern glassmorphism personal portfolio with particle effects, dark mode, JSON-driven content, animations, and full responsiveness.
longDescription: Designed and built from scratch using pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Features include a floating particle background, custom cursor, typing animation, scroll reveal animations, dynamic JSON loading for projects and achievements, working contact form with validation, light/dark mode with localStorage, and a fully responsive layout.

title: Student Result Management System
description: A DBMS mini-project for managing student records, grades, and result generation using MySQL and a C-based CLI interface.
longDescription: This project uses MySQL as the backend database and a C program as the CLI frontend. Features include student registration, course enrollment, marks entry, result computation (SGPA/CGPA), and report generation. Demonstrates practical DBMS concepts like normalization, joins, and stored procedures.

title: Binary Search Tree Operations
description: Implementation of BST with insert, delete, search, traversals (inorder, preorder, postorder), height calculation, and level-order traversal in C++.
longDescription: A comprehensive C++ implementation of Binary Search Tree covering all fundamental operations. Includes recursive and iterative approaches, tree visualization in terminal, and complexity analysis comments. Serves as a learning reference for DSA preparation and coding interviews.
